subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this repository-scoped durable drainer and captured one-shot requeue authority as the repair automation contract?
rationale: The patch appears correct and fixes the known dispatcher-loss defect, but it intentionally changes central concurrency, durable-state, and mutation-authority behavior whose operational ownership belongs to repository maintainers.

options.title: Adopt after green check
options.body: Merge after the exact-head full check succeeds, preserving the reviewed durable queue and fail-closed authority design.

options.title: Require hosted edge proof
options.body: Keep the draft open for additional live exercises of pending-run coalescing, interruption recovery, and unauthorized requeue rejection.

options.title: Retain the current contract
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want the operational complexity of a shared durable dispatcher.

recommendation.title: Adopt after green check
recommendation.body: Merge after the exact-head full check succeeds, preserving the reviewed durable queue and fail-closed authority design.
